title: Steering Vectors as a Training Signal in LLM Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.40998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Steering vectors (SVs) are residual-stream directions that shift the behavior of LLMs when added to hidden states at inference time. While prior work has mainly used SVs as post-hoc controls, we ask whether the same directions can also guide parameter updates during post-training. We study this question across supervised learning, including SFT and distillation, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Our framework considers two intervention regimes: a hidden-state hook during teacher-forced supervised training, and an advantage-repair mechanism on wrong rollouts in GRPO. For each regime, we analyze three design axes, which are the steering direction, its placement, and the operation used to combine it with training. In supervised settings, SV injection improves over plain SFT and distillation, with gains scaling with the off-policy gap and reaching up to a $12\%$ improvement when distilling from thinking-mode teachers

translated_title: 导向向量作为大语言模型后训练中的训练信号
translated_abstract: 导向向量（SVs）是残差流中的方向，在推理时将其添加到隐藏状态中可以改变大语言模型的行为。虽然先前的工作主要将导向向量用作事后控制手段，我们探究这些方向是否也能在后训练过程中引导参数更新。我们在监督学习（包括SFT和蒸馏）以及可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中研究这一问题。我们的框架考虑了两种干预机制：教师强制监督训练期间的隐藏状态钩子，以及GRPO中针对错误rollout的优势修复机制。对于每种机制，我们分析了三个设计维度：导向方向、其放置位置以及将其与训练结合所用的操作。在监督学习设置中，导向向量注入优于普通的SFT和蒸馏，其收益随离策略差距的增大而扩大，在从思考模式教师模型蒸馏时最高可达12%的性能提升。
tldr: 本文首次将导向向量从推理时的事后控制手段拓展为后训练中的训练信号，通过隐藏状态钩子和GRPO优势修复两种干预机制引导参数更新，在监督学习与强化学习场景中均优于基线方法，蒸馏场景下最高提升12%。
en_tdlr: This paper pioneers using steering vectors as training signals rather than post-hoc controls during LLM post-training, via hidden-state hooks and GRPO advantage-repair mechanisms, improving over plain SFT and distillation with gains up to 12% when distilling from thinking-mode teachers.
